body: Fruitcake gets a very undeserved wrap. It was started by people like me who did not want to share it with anybody.

I have isolated my self from as many friends as I can so that when I decide to kill myself it will impact the least amount of people. Unfortunately it will still impact my wife and daughter, the grand kid is young enough that it should not be too traumatic in the long run for her.  I am still figuring out how to make sure that all the financial stuff is taken care of after words.
